candidates.title: Furie
candidates.reason: Across its 98-minute runtime, the short rural setup gives way to a sustained rescue pursuit, a motorcycle attack, repeated fights through Saigon and a climactic train battle. Cinema.de reports a modern, dynamic style and high pace with few exceptions; Kung-fu Kingdom traces frequent combat through the middle and finale. Film Inquiry offers a useful counterpoint: some exposition interrupts the action, so the density assessment is strong but not near-continuous. The hook is a determined, physically formidable mother facing traffickers, not high-concept sci-fi; most action is hand-to-hand with limited vehicular set pieces.

candidates.title: The Killer
candidates.reason: The 95-minute South Korean retired-hitman rescue thriller builds a chain of fights and shootings in distinct locations. City on Fire describes a quick setup followed by action across much of the film; Mark Reviews Movies details repeated brawls and shootouts at a rink, hotel, port and estate. TheWrap praises inventive guns/axes/melee choreography but notes an overexplained first act and lulls around the teenager's subplot. Accordingly the whole-runtime action is assessed as recurring rather than near-continuous, and the strong one-person-army combat appeal is offset by a conventional rescue premise and uneven pacing.

research_rejections.title: The Big 4
research_rejections.reason: Although the film has exuberant gunplay and comic violence, its 141-minute runtime and the prominent Rotten Tomatoes-cited RogerEbert.com criticism of an overlong, talky structure make sustained action density less convincing than the selected alternatives; https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/the_big_4.

research_rejections.title: Revenger
research_rejections.reason: Its prison-island martial arts battles are striking, but AsianMovieWeb describes long gaps after the introduction, action picking up only around the 30-minute mark and extended pauses later; this conflicts with claims of virtually nonstop combat. Not prioritized without reliable whole-runtime density; https://www.asianmovieweb.com/de/reviews/revenger.htm.
